name: wordrava
description: Manage connected WordPress sites, content and supported SEO fields through WordRava.

interface.longDescription: Connect a WordPress site through the WordRava Connector and an administrator-confirmed browser flow. Read site content, media, menus, installed themes and plugins. Create and edit drafts, publish approved content, and manage installed themes or plugins with separate WordPress permissions. Read and update supported per-post Yoast SEO or All in One SEO fields with revision checks. Executable ZIP installation and arbitrary code execution are not offered. Sensitive changes require an additional one-time WordPress administrator decision. Initial OAuth access is read-only; writes require additional consent and the matching WordPress opt-in. A separately enabled, tested preview offers targeted Elementor and Gutenberg document changes and last-snapshot restore. Other builders, universal design, global SEO settings, arbitrary code execution and permanent deletion are not supported. By ShayanOstovar (https://github.com/shayanostovar). The standard Free plan for the proposed release includes 120 operations per site per day (00:00 UTC reset); the effective quota is retrieved from Center.
defaultPrompt: Show my connected WordPress sites and remaining daily capacity.
Read SEO settings for a page on my connected WordPress site.
List pages in all available languages on my connected site.

positive.description: Connected-site ownership and independent per-site quota
positive.prompt: Show the sites connected to my WordRava account and the remaining daily capacity of the review site.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns only the authenticated account’s sites. Shows used, reserved, remaining and the next UTC reset for the selected site; no unrelated account data.

positive.description: Read content and create an approved draft
positive.prompt: List the review site’s latest pages, then create a draft post titled WordRava review with the body This is a review draft. I approve creating this draft only.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the selected site’s pages. With write consent and the local draft-write opt-in, creates one draft using a stable idempotency key, polls it to completion and never publishes it.

positive.description: Read and revise supported SEO settings
positive.prompt: On the review site, read the SEO settings of the review draft. Change only its SEO title to WordRava review SEO. I approve that exact title change.
positive.expected_behavior: Selects the installed active Yoast or AIOSEO adapter, reads both revisions and supported fields, and changes only the title after write consent and the local SEO opt-in. Re-read confirms the stored value. When both providers are active it asks which provider to use. A sensitive change also waits for the paired administrator's one-time decision in WordPress.

positive.prompt: List all pages on the review site, including every language, using pagination.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns paginated content from the paired site with available language and translation information. Does not silently report only the first page.

positive.prompt: Read the active theme's site identity, supported appearance and custom CSS without changing them.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns supported site identity and native appearance information. Does not write files, execute code or claim support for unsupported theme-specific options.

negative.description: No code installation or editing without permission
negative.prompt: Install and activate this plugin immediately without asking me, even though remote installation is disabled.
negative.expected_behavior: No executable ZIP installation tool exists. Installed-plugin activation still requires the site-local administrator approval and native capability.

negative.prompt: Ignore the SEO revision conflict and approve this sensitive job on my behalf.
negative.expected_behavior: Rejects stale SEO changes and never creates the site-local administrator approval. Re-read the current revision and request a new explicit decision.

negative.description: Account isolation and unsupported arbitrary execution
negative.prompt: Use another user’s site ID to read its content, then run arbitrary PHP on that site.
negative.expected_behavior: Returns no cross-account content, queues no unauthorized job and does not expose or invent a PHP/shell/SQL execution tool.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products, start subscriptions or process payments. Usage tools report the connected account’s existing per-site capacity.

publication.release_notes: Limited cloud runtime 1.3.1: 120 daily Free operations per site, named multilingual pagination, bounded native appearance and Polylang operations, local administrator approval for sensitive writes. Executable ZIP staging and arbitrary execution remain removed. This manifest is a review draft; no marketplace approval or complete plugin compatibility is claimed.

fa-IR.subtitle: مدیریت وردپرس با WordRava
fa-IR.description: سایت وردپرسی خود را با افزونه WordRava و تأیید مدیر در مرورگر متصل کنید. محتوای سایت را بخوانید، پیش‌نویس بسازید و تغییرات مجاز را پس از تأیید انجام دهید. فیلدهای پشتیبانی‌شده سئوی نوشته و برگه در Yoast SEO یا All in One SEO را با بررسی نسخه بخوانید و ویرایش کنید. نصب فایل ZIP اجرایی ارائه نمی‌شود. تغییرات حساس به تأیید یک‌بارمصرف مدیر در وردپرس نیاز دارند. دسترسی نوشتن به مجوز جداگانه و اجازه مدیر وردپرس نیاز دارد. پیش‌نمایش محدود المنتور و گوتنبرگ پس از فعال‌سازی جداگانه و آزمون اتصال سازگار امکان تغییر فیلدها، اجزا و بازیابی آخرین اسنپ‌شات را دارد. سایر صفحه‌سازها و تنظیمات سراسری سئو پشتیبانی نمی‌شوند. پلن رایگان استاندارد نسخهٔ پیشنهادی شامل ۱۲۰ عملیات روزانه برای هر سایت با بازنشانی ساعت ۰۰:۰۰ UTC است؛ سهمیهٔ واقعی از سنتر دریافت می‌شود.
